messages:
eve (eng-release): heads-up — deploy-bot is throttling the eu-west promotion for release v2.14.3 due to regional backpressure. I think this is the burst limiter kicking in, not a helm issue.
mike (eng-sre): saw the alert. deploy-bot posted `promotion-blocked: capacity:eu-west:high` earlier.
 deploy-bot: Promotion stalled: target=eu-west, chart=service-api v2.14.3, reason=regional_gpu_quota_exceeded, retry=automatic in 5m :warning:
sarah (platform): is the canary already partially promoted in eu-west or still in staging?
eve (eng-release): partial — 10% traffic routed, 3 pods in canary, readiness fine but queue depth >100 for hostpool-3.
tom (eng): that queue depth suggests burst traffic; we should avoid a full roll before we clear KV cache and scale up. Can we push a transient values override to reduce worker concurrency?
mike (eng-sre): +1 to temporary values tweak. Suggest `workers.concurrency: 8` and `batcher.max_batch_size: 16` for the eu-west canary.
sarah (platform): We can do a targeted `helm upgrade --install service-api --set workers.concurrency=8 -n eu-west` but need a manual pin so the global promotion doesn't pick a newer chart while we're throttled.
julia (product): we'll need release notes updated if we pin — add note: "delaying full promotion due to regional capacity, no functional changes" so customer comms are covered.
eve (eng-release): agree. Action plan: 1) apply values override to canary in eu-west (manual helm), 2) pin chart for promotion window, 3) annotate release notes, 4) let deploy-bot retry. Anyone object?
mike (eng-sre): no objections. I'll prepare the kube commands and watch autoscaler.
tom (eng): command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
helm upgrade --install service-api eucharts/service-api --namespace eu-west --set workers.concurrency=8 --reuse-values --timeout 5m
kubectl annotate rollout service-api app.kubernetes.io/rollout-pause=true -n eu-west --overwrite
```
Note: annotate to prevent automated promotion until we confirm stability.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. I'll hold automatic promotion for 30m for this release (override by @eve).
eve (eng-release): I'll add the pin: `promotion.lock=3476543210-pin-euw` in the release metadata and update release-notes draft.
julia (product): added the blurb to release notes, marked as internal note for now. :white_check_mark:
mike (eng-sre): scaling: increased nodepool target by +1 in eu-west; watching pod startup.
sarah (platform): once queue drops below 30 for 10m we can unpause rollout. Recommend also enabling prefix KV cache warmup.
tom (eng): KV warmup job scheduled in staging->eu-west for 3m window. I'll post logs to the thread.
eve (eng-release): thanks — I'll unpin and trigger promotion after we verify 10m stable. If deploy-bot still rejects, we'll fallback to rolling by image only across regions.
mike (eng-sre): noted. ping me if any 5xx spikes. :eyes:
